Questions people ask.

Do I train with Luke in person?

No. You get a plan built around you and you carry it out in your own gym and your own kitchen. Luke checks in, looks at what actually happened, and adjusts the plan.

Is this for men and women?

Yes. Luke coaches both, mostly around dropping body fat, building a body that performs, and improving health.

I work shifts and have a family. Will it fit?

The plan is built around the week you actually have, not the one you wish you had. Sarah's result came with shift work and kids in the way.

Do I have to give up my weekends?

No. Weekends, meals out and social events are planned for, not avoided. That is a large part of why the result lasts.

£650 to build and launch it, then the monthly plan on a 12-month minimum term. No-BS Advisory can be added to any plan at £150 a month. Add-on to any tier. Never sold on its own.

The terms, in plain words

  • The £650 to build it is paid up front. Your monthly plan starts the day the site goes live.
  • You own it. Your domain stays registered to you; we manage the DNS and the hosting.
  • Every monthly plan carries a minimum term, to protect the build from churn right after go-live.

What happens next

  1. You tell us what is wrong in the demo: the prices, the hours, the photos, the words.
  2. We correct it and put your real details in, and you look again.
  3. If you want it, it goes live on your own domain, and you own it.
